content.short: Petra Wallet is the official self-custody wallet for the Aptos ecosystem, providing secure asset management.
content.description: Petra Wallet is the premier decentralized wallet natively developed by Aptos Labs to provide users with a secure and intuitive gateway to the Aptos blockchain. As a self-custody solution, Petra ensures that users maintain full control over their private keys and digital assets while enjoying a seamless experience across Aptos-based dApps. The wallet features a suite of built-in tools for asset management, NFT discovery, and direct integration with the network's leading DeFi protocols. Petra Wallet focuses on security, performance, and accessibility, making it an essential component for both new and experienced users navigating the rapidly expanding Aptos Layer 1 landscape.
content.meta: Petra Wallet is the leading self-custody wallet for Aptos, offering secure asset management and seamless integration with the Aptos ecosystem.
